title: Design & Code: Lightning Talks 2026 ⚡

location.name: Crews Center for Entrepreneurship, University of Memphis

summary: Lighting talks are back! Join our Memphis community for a night of short, high-energy talks, networking, food, and conversation about projects, ideas, and lessons learned.

description.whoIsThisFor: This event is for designers, developers, builders, and curious new faces in the Memphis tech community. Whether you're a seasoned creator or just getting started, you'll find a welcoming room full of people sharing what they're working on and learning.

agenda.details: Meet new faces, grab some food, and connect with the local tech and startup community.

Several Memphis community members will give short, ~7 minute talks about their projects, interests, and lessons learned. This is an elevator pitch-style format designed to spark ideas, conversation, and inspiration.
Ask questions, share ideas, meet other developers and creators, and continue the conversation with the people in the room.

rsvp.details: Please confirm your attendance through Meetup so we can plan accordingly for food and seating.
